text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> and I are out shopping for shoes when we run into Trainer Kiryuin and Happy Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Trainer <username>! Are you buying shoes as well?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Of course! After all, a first-rate Umamusume needs first-rate gear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I start looking through the shelves alongside an excited Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Look, Meek! It's those new shoes from the magazine.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Their performance is backed up by sports science and endorsed by top-level Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I see…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: But from a comfort perspective, the shoes next to them are the way to go.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: This model has excellent cushioning and reduces strain on the legs.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Considering your running style, these may be the better choice.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Right…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Happy Meek nods. She opens her mouth as if to speak, but closes it again without saying anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I realize she's staring at something and follow her gaze to another pair of shoes. If my hunch is correct…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Right, I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Could you wait here, Meek? I'm just going to go pay.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: All right…
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you tell her you want those shoes?
Shouldn't you tell her you want those shoes?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: No… It's all right. I'm happy with the shoes my trainer picked out for me.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I know she's just thinking about what's best for me… She works really hard, you know.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: So it's fine… I just thought those shoes looked like baguettes, that's all.
choice_data_list: She'll be happier if you're honest with her.
She'll be happier if you're honest with her.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: You… really think so?
choice_data_list: I'm a trainer too. I know these things.
I'm a trainer too. I know these things.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Thank you… I'll go and tell her…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Meek…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I got so caught up in doing what I thought was best, I didn't think to consider you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: What's most important is that the shoes fit your desires. Asking you how you felt should have been the first thing I did.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Let's go back to the store and choose again, shall we? This time, together.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Thank you for looking out for Meek, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I also want to say… thank you.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: From now on… I'll tell my trainer what I want when we're choosing shoes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After seeing off Trainer Kiryuin, <chrname> and I pick out a pair of shoes that fit her preferences.
